section.title: From Idea to
section.description: I follow a structured development process to turn ideas into fast, responsive, maintainable, and user-friendly web applications.

steps.title: Understand
steps.subtitle: Understanding the idea and requirements
steps.description: I start by understanding the project idea, its goals, target users, required features, and the overall problem the website needs to solve.
highlights: Break the idea into clear features

steps.title: Plan
steps.subtitle: Creating a clear development direction
steps.description: Before writing code, I plan the structure of the application, reusable components, page sections, data flow, and technologies that fit the project.

steps.title: Design
steps.subtitle: Creating a clean and responsive interface
steps.description: I focus on creating interfaces that are visually clean, easy to understand, responsive across devices, and consistent throughout the application.

steps.title: Develop
steps.subtitle: Turning ideas into working applications
steps.description: I build the interface using modern web technologies and reusable components, keeping the code structured, maintainable, and type-safe.

steps.title: Test & Improve
steps.subtitle: Checking, optimizing, and refining
steps.description: Once the main features are working, I test the application, find issues, improve the user experience, and optimize the implementation where needed.

steps.title: Deploy
steps.subtitle: Taking the project to production
steps.description: After the application is ready, I prepare it for production and deploy it so the website can be accessed reliably by real users.

philosophy.title: Build.
philosophy.description: Every project gives me an opportunity to learn something new, solve problems, improve my development process, and build better experiences.
